notes: Code names are encoded with nicknamed (the nearest catalogued relation; there is no code-name relation in RELATIONS.md), and a code name names one product (firm InvFunc(nicknamed)). successor_of is functional and the inverse of predecessor_of (catalogue); that Windows XP did not introduce the Start menu and was built on the NT kernel are the stored originals of q1 and q2 (class memberships, firm). The question 'the OS code-named Longhorn' is a placeholder individual given its code name.
